CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation present linking to identified content.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red) is given, its organization (red/blue block partition) is specified, and an origin/status field is present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to content organization/presentation/access was stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colored content (red) with coordinate sets.

D.rationale: The report separates content listings (red coordinates) from an explicit origin/status field for the same referent, distinguishing content from its status/origin.

O.rationale: The report explicitly presents how content is organized (partitioned coordinate groups) for the given referent/time.
